title: A Retire check that cannot finish in the merge tool's time limit is refused before the batch
why: A debt's Retire check that runs the whole hooks/test_guard.py can never pass the merge tool's 600 s limit. The refusal shows only at merge, after a full green CI run, so the batch drops late.
note: Coordinator 11:52 CST Nov 10, from runner 8's drop of #2119. Fix: the release check (or `merge --reviewed`) runs each Retire check, or refuses one that names a whole suite, before the batch. Follows step debt-close-runs-retire (done, 750cdcd08), which added the Retire run at merge. #2119's lane session_013NEJL29GcaaeoS7a1SJYA2 was unarchived to fix its three checks.
